slug.description: The name a client reads this datapoint by.

builtin.description: `true` for the datapoints every robot has — `bridge_state`, `robot_details` and `bridge_pressure` — and `false` for everything the published configuration adds.

unit.description: The unit the value carries **after** any scale and offset, shown beside the number so nobody has to guess whether `15` means percent, volts or minutes. `null` when the configuration names none.

rate_throttle_hz.description: The ceiling on how often this datapoint is sent, in hertz. `null` means no ceiling is configured, which is also the answer for every built-in. A ceiling, not a clock: a slow topic stays slow and no value is repeated to manufacture a rate.

datapoints.description: Everything a client may read on this robot: the three built-ins, plus every datapoint the published configuration exposes and the caller's role grants.
